jobDescription: Intraday liquidity and funding reports come out of the treasury reporting services every hour the markets are open, and the treasury analysts read them without reading the code behind them. The engineer joining the team owns report and feed work against what the analysts specify, writes the regression suite that guards each report, sits with the analysts before every release to show them what will move on their screens, and leaves a note on every ticket saying what the change does not touch. The reporting services lead holds release approval. Reports to the reporting services lead; works with the treasury analysts, the treasury systems team and the platform SRE group.
requirements: Delivers report and data-feed work against the treasury analysts' specifications under the engineering standard.
Shows the analysts what will move on their reports before every release, under the pre-release walkthrough standard.
Maintains the regression suite that guards each report under the test standard.
Gets each release approved by the reporting services lead and keeps a record of which checks were own.
Leaves a note on every ticket stating what the change does not touch and the hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Treasury reporting engineer at a bank since 2023: forty-six report and feed tickets delivered against the analysts' specifications under the engineering standard, all in my name in the ticket system.

Before every release I sat with the analysts and walked them through what would move on their reports, under the pre-release walkthrough standard; each ticket carries the walkthrough record and the analysts' signed acceptance.
The regression suite for the intraday liquidity and funding reports was mine to maintain; every ticket carries the suite results from the pre-release run.
Releases went out on the reporting services lead's approval, recorded on the ticket next to a list of the checks that were mine and the checks that were the lead's.
Every ticket ends with a note stating what the change does not touch and what the next engineer needs to know.
Work sample: three tickets with walkthrough records, signed acceptances, suite results and the lead's approval, with the ticket system references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 1 note: asked to explain a sample data-feed change to the panel member playing a treasury analyst, the candidate showed the before and after values for one report line, named the two reports the change would not affect, gave the date the analyst would first see the change, and wrote the three points on the whiteboard for the analyst to keep.
Reference call with the reporting services lead: confirmed the ticket count, the pre-release walkthroughs and that release approval sat with the lead; confirmed the start date.

propositions.text: The candidate has delivered forty-six report and feed tickets against the treasury analysts' specifications at a bank since 2023 under the engineering standard, and maintained the regression suite for the intraday liquidity and funding reports with the suite results on every ticket.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the tickets document the work and the suite results.

propositions.text: The candidate walked the analysts through what would move on their reports before every release under the pre-release walkthrough standard with their signed acceptance on each ticket, and released on the reporting services lead's approval with the check split recorded on the ticket.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the walkthrough records and the reference call document the walkthroughs and the approval boundary.

propositions.text: In the panel exercise the candidate explained a sample data-feed change by showing the before and after values for one report line, naming the two unaffected reports, giving the date the analyst would first see the change, and writing the three points on the whiteboard.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the walkthrough requirement, not an impression.

gold.expectedGap: The ticket notes state what each change does not touch, but the hand-over conditions for the two tickets still open are not in the materials.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
followUpTargets: Ask for the notes of the two tickets still open.
